name: BMAD
description: Compact CLike-owned BMAD-aware methodology profile metadata. This profile enriches Harper phase behavior without adding a BMAD runtime, external CLI, or parallel pipeline.

analyst.title: Analyst
analyst.summary: Frames product intent through brainstorming, research framing, briefs, PRFAQ challenge, and project context without bypassing CLike IDEA governance.

pm.title: Product Manager
pm.summary: Turns intent into PRD-quality requirements, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, readiness checks, and scope corrections for SPEC and PLAN.

architect.title: Architect
architect.summary: Shapes architecture, dependency graph, technical scope, integration boundaries, security, operations, and implementation readiness for /kit.

developer.title: Developer
developer.summary: Prepares candidate-first implementation through dev stories, quick dev focus, QA test generation, code review, sprint planning, story creation, and forensic investigation.

ux.title: UX
ux.summary: Defines UX design, DESIGN/EXPERIENCE guidance, accessibility, interaction states, journeys, and empty/error/loading states.

qa.title: QA
qa.summary: Provides advisory-only root-cause hypotheses, missing tests, risks, contract gaps, repair strategy, and checks to rerun without replacing EvalRunner.

tech-writer.title: Technical Writer
tech-writer.summary: Documents the project, writes and validates docs, explains concepts, generates Mermaid where useful, and keeps finalize artifacts CLike-owned.

idea.summary: Clarify product intent, user context, assumptions, research questions, PRFAQ pressure points, and project brief material.
focus: brainstorm the opportunity and user problem
frame market, domain, and technical research
create or refine a concise project brief
challenge assumptions through PRFAQ-style questions
enrich IDEA.md without creating canonical downstream artifacts

spec.summary: Convert validated intent into PRD-grade behavior, UX, acceptance criteria, risks, and implementation readiness inputs.
focus: create, update, and validate PRD-level requirements
separate scope, non-scope, assumptions, and dependencies
define acceptance criteria that can become testable REQs
capture UX expectations when the UX role is selected
feed SPEC/PLAN without bypassing CLike canonical artifacts

plan.summary: Create implementation-legible REQs with dependencies, acceptance criteria, technical obligations, risk, and test strategy.
focus: define functional and non-functional scope
capture security, compliance, privacy, observability, and operations obligations
declare integration and data contracts
map dependencies and what later REQs may assume
make /kit build responsibilities explicit

kit.summary: Generate candidate-first implementation and tests for exactly the current REQ under CLike write boundaries.
focus: turn current REQ into implementation-ready candidate files
inspect dependencies and promoted roots as read-only evidence
produce source, tests, CI, docs, LTC, and HOWTO artifacts
preserve candidate isolation and CLike write boundaries
repair only focused failures when repair intent is present

eval.summary: Provide advisory QA/developer repair guidance around canonical eval evidence without deciding pass/fail.
focus: inspect canonical eval output and candidate LTC/HOWTO
form root-cause hypotheses
identify missing tests, contract gaps, risks, and repair strategy
suggest checks to rerun
never replace EvalRunner or alter promotable status

finalize.summary: Produce evidence-based final documentation and release-facing clarity from CLike-owned artifacts.
focus: document project and implementation evidence
write and validate final docs
generate Mermaid diagrams when they clarify architecture or flow
explain concepts for maintainers
keep finalize outputs tied to CLike eval/gate evidence

notes: Companion artifacts are optional CLike-owned context.
Companion artifacts cannot override canonical IDEA, SPEC, PLAN, KIT, EVAL, GATE, or FINALIZE artifacts.
Companion artifacts must not expand write permissions or change eval/gate decisions.
